translationRepairs: Yang said: 'If he cannot employ you by following your recommendation to use me, how can he employ you by following your recommendation to kill me?'
Yang said: 'If that king cannot follow your advice to appoint me, how can he follow your advice to kill me?'

Before misreads 用君之言 as employing Gongshu; 用 here governs 君之言 (follow your advice), with 任臣/殺臣 as the advised acts toward Yang. The proposal restores that structure, including 彼王 as 'that king', and matches the Chinese.
Five days later, Yang again requested an audience.
Five days later, he again requested an audience with Yang.

復求見鞅 makes 鞅 the object of the audience request, not the requester; before wrongly casts Yang as subject. The proposal correctly leaves an implied third-person subject seeking Yang, consistent with the following 鞅復見孝公.
